s.t: Although empathy praises widely by scholars and public figures, [해석] not everyone is an empathy booster.

______, they argue, empathy makes such conflicts better.
These critics maintain that empathy can be exhausted and lead to burnout or sensitivity to suffering.
They argue that we tend to empathize strong with our in-group and resist to empathize with out-groups, and even enjoy the suffering of out-groups in competitive or threatened contexts.
Empathy, they argue, can further discourage conflict and force us into an us vs. them mentality.

______, even when we try to empathize with others who are dissimilar from us or in familiar contexts, sometimes we are able to accurately empathize with their experiences, caused further misunderstandings and frustration.
Critics of empathy argues that we should give up on empathy and employ another tools in pursuit of social harmony, e.g., irrational compassion or mortal emotions alike fear, anger, and shame.
